de.abas.erp.db.selection

Class Conditions

  • Object
    • Conditions

  • public class Conditions
extends Object
    A factory class for the different types of Conditions that restricts a selection's result set. This equates the possible Conditions of the abas selection syntax. See Online Help - Field conditions for Details.
    Author:
    mm
